description: Specify fracture group names. Use of the group logic is described in Groups . By default, s is assigned to the default slot Default . Use the remove keyword to remove s from all slots.
notes: To scope the assignment to the fractures of ONE DFN, use 'range fish <fn>' with a FISH function filtering on the fracture (official pattern), or assign the group right when each fracture is created. 'range dfn <name>' does NOT work here - that range element selects by distance from a DFN, not by membership, and fracture-scoped commands reject it.

Groups are the route to per-family fracture visualization: the fracture plot item has no per-DFN color attribute, but supports 'color-by text-attribute' with value 'group' followed by a slot name or the keyword Any, and 'range group <name>'.

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Assign group s to the slot named slot . By default, slot Default is used.

examples.command: fracture group 'large' slot 'size' range fish mylarge
examples.description: Official pattern: assign group via a FISH filter function (mylarge returns 1 for fractures with area > 4); "fracture group 'small' slot 'size' range fish mylarge not" assigns the complement
No range: assigns the group to ALL fractures (slot Default)
